method: Parent integration smoke checks using DOM button clicks, local state assertions and html_preview rendering; native mouse/wheel/touch validation is recorded separately in the agent's checks.json.

checks.name: Editor pill opens existing timeline workspace
Navigation does not add or seek
Missing opens dedicated form at exact gap
Cancel adds nothing and returns Browse
Editor pill exits add form without creating
Add to Editor switch preserves Browse origin
Explicit Add creates exactly one rally
Existing Editor sees added shared rally

limitations: Standalone HTML representation of the existing Android Editor; no native app launch or real export.
